faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions about our vermicompost products
faq.a1: Vermicompost is organic fertilizer produced through the breakdown of organic matter by earthworms. It's rich in nutrients and highly beneficial for soil.
faq.q2: How much should I use for my plants?
faq.a2: For potted plants, use 100-200g per pot every 15 days. For agricultural land, 1-2 tons per acre is recommended depending on the crop.
faq.q3: Is it safe for all types of plants?
faq.a3: Yes, our vermicompost is 100% natural and safe for all plants including vegetables, fruits, flowers, and agricultural crops.
faq.a4: Yes, we arrange bulk delivery across Karnataka. Please contact us with your location and requirement.
